description: This source file defines the WellKnownTypeCollection class used in Orleans.Serialization for managing mappings between well-known type identifiers and their corresponding Type objects, facilitating serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: WellKnownTypeCollection
classes.description: A collection managing well-known types and their identifiers for serialization purposes.

methods.name: GetWellKnownType
methods.description: Retrieves the Type associated with a given type identifier.

methods.name: TryGetWellKnownType
methods.description: Attempt to retrieve a Type using its type identifier, returning success status.

methods.name: TryGetWellKnownTypeId
methods.description: Attempts to get the type identifier associated with a given Type.
